messages:
marta (partnerships): Morning — quick sync: Skyline Labs preview access is green, NDA signed by legal yesterday. We need to hand off telemetry schema, bench config, and confirm next week's 48h bench window. Who owns telemetry dashboard?

aj (eng): Nice. I can own dashboard. Need sample telemetry schema + where to drop logs. https://drive.company.com/skyline/eap :thumbsup:

samir (eng-ml): Re: bench window — can we do Tue-Wed 22:00-22:00 UTC? Works for bench team. Also need the model image and SSH keys.

marta (partnerships): Tue-Wed works. Skyline asked for preflight checklist; draft is in drive. Nina from Skyline wants access for their SRE — we need to confirm SSH firewall & IP allowlist.

lee (ops): Provisioned host.

deploy-bot: Provisioned skyline-eap-01, ip 34.201.45.12, user redwood-eap

lee (ops): Use this to push image and run bench:

```
scp build/image.tar.gz redwood-eap@34.201.45.12:/tmp/
ssh -i eap-key.pem redwood-eap@34.201.45.12 'sudo docker load -i /tmp/image.tar.gz && sudo docker run --rm -v /data:/data skyline-bench --config /data/bench.json'
```

samir (eng-ml): Also add --telemetry-endpoint env var. Minimal bench config snippet:

```
{
  "model": "gpt-xxl",
  "sequence_length": 4096,
  "batch_sizes": [1,4,8],
  "telemetry": {"endpoint":"https://ingest.redwood.internal/eap","auth":"token"}
}
```

aj (eng): For auth we'll use short-lived tokens; I'll generate and drop in the drive secrets doc. marta, can you confirm partner contact email? we'll send firewall IP list.

marta (partnerships): skyline-sre@skyline.com — added. Also we need to add data privacy note — bench dataset contains snippets, ensure it's synthetic + approved. @samir can you sanitize logs to remove prompt text? :thinking_face:

samir (eng-ml): yep, will redact by default; also add sample preflight healthcheck:

```
curl -sS http://34.201.45.12:9100/health || exit 1
```

lee (ops): I'll update the handoff doc and run the allowlist change after you give me final IPs. Done by EOD Monday.

deploy-bot: Lab seat assigned: skyline-eap-01 -> bench-team (slot 08/01 22:00 UTC)

marta (partnerships): awesome — next steps: aj owns dash, lee handles infra, samir handles redaction & bench config. I'll draft announcement sync for partners + comms. :white_check_mark:
